title: Ensuring Transplant Establishment and Seedling Emergence
summary: Initial watering, a thin 1 cm mulch layer, updating your crop plan, and first maintenance tasks (hoeing, hilling, weeding) after sowing or transplanting.

pages.title: Helping your seedlings and young transplants get off to a good start
pages.text:
Once the seed is sown or the young plant transplanted, you need to help it develop well.

**Initial watering**, **mulching** and **bed maintenance** are essential to ensure seedling emergence and transplant establishment, and therefore a good harvest.
pages.illustration_description: Planche permanente en pleine terre paillée en Afrique de l'Ouest montrant de jeunes plants vigoureux et des semis en cours de levée, baignés d'une douce lumière matinale.

pages.title: 1. Water immediately after sowing or transplanting
pages.text:
Proper initial watering is essential **immediately after** transplanting or sowing: it promotes good seedling emergence and quick establishment of young transplants.

Use a **watering can** fitted with a fine rose, or turn on the **sprinkler system** if one is already installed.
pages.illustration_description: Une agricultrice ouest-africaine arrosant immédiatement en pluie fine avec un arrosoir une planche en pleine terre fraîchement transplantée, depuis le passe-pied.

pages.title: How much water and when?
pages.text:
- **How much water should you apply?** Make sure the soil around each plant is moistened deeply, without creating waterlogging.
- **When is the best time?** In the following days, water in the **early morning** or **late afternoon** to minimize evaporation and make the most of the water.
pages.illustration_description: Coupe pédagogique du sol en aquarelle sous une lumière dorée de début de matinée : l'eau pénètre doucement en profondeur autour des racines d'un jeune plant sans flaques en surface.

pages.title: 2. Why mulch?
pages.text:
After sowing or transplanting, cover your beds with a thin layer of mulch (straw, hay, dry leaves or groundnut shells).

Mulch helps to:
1. **Protect** seeds and young plants from being washed away during the rainy season.
2. **Retain soil moisture**.
3. **Regulate temperature** and limit thermal shocks.
4. **Reduce crusting** and make seedling emergence easier.
pages.illustration_description: Gros plan en aquarelle sur une planche en pleine terre recouverte d'un fin tapis de paille dorée et de coques d'arachide protégeant le sol humide et de délicates jeunes pousses.

pages.title: How to mulch properly without smothering the plants?
pages.text:
For successful mulching after sowing or transplanting:

- Spread a **thin layer of about 1 cm** so as not to smother the seedlings.
- Use **clean mulch**, free of unwanted weed seeds.
- Spread it evenly while **leaving a small gap** around the stem of young plants.
pages.illustration_description: Mains ouest-africaines répartissant avec délicatesse une fine couche de paille hachée autour de jeunes plants sur une planche en pleine terre, en laissant un léger dégagement autour des collets.

pages.title: 3. Update your crop plan
pages.text:
If you can, update your **annual crop plan** by recording the **actual sowing or transplanting date**, so you know whether it differs from the planned date.

This allows you to:
- Keep track of successes and challenges encountered.
- Optimize your future planning.
pages.illustration_description: Un agriculteur ouest-africain debout près de sa parcelle maraîchère, tenant un carnet ouvert et un crayon pour noter ses observations de suivi, sans aucun texte lisible sur les pages.

pages.title: 4. Hoeing, hilling and weeding
pages.text:
**Two to three weeks** after sowing or transplanting, a first maintenance pass may be necessary:

- **Hoeing**: lightly break the surface crust to aerate the soil.
- **Hilling**: draw a little soil up around the base of plants that need it.
- **Weeding**: remove competing weeds while they are still young.
pages.illustration_description: Une agricultrice ouest-africaine dans un passe-pied utilisant une petite binette entre des rangs bien alignés de jeunes légumes sur une planche permanente en pleine terre.

pages.title: Conclusion: vigorous crops from the start
pages.text:
**Congratulations!** You now master the essential practices to ensure good establishment of your young transplants and even emergence of your seedlings.

These simple but decisive practices give your crops all the vigor they need for an abundant harvest.
pages.illustration_description: Parcelle maraîchère ouest-africaine florissante avec des planches permanentes en pleine terre paillées, couvertes de jeunes cultures denses et vigoureuses, sous un ciel lumineux.
